hero.title: One group, three companies, one goal: helping you move better.
hero.lede: Gruppo Lobra brings together different expertise — Customer Experience, Microsoft, SAP — under one approach: people-first and results-driven.

identity.title: People first
identity.body1: This is where every project starts: with people, not with technology. Our DNA is a people-first approach that puts the people who work with and for our clients at the centre.
identity.body2: We believe complexity is tackled with method, not shortcuts. That's why we build long-term relationships, not one-off projects.

offices.title: Where we work, every day
offices.lede: Five offices in Italy and one international office in Dublin.

care.title: Lobra gives back
care.lede: We believe a company should give value back to the community it operates in. That's why we support organisations that work every day for those who need it most.

footer.tagline: Since 2016 we've turned complexity into direction.
